name: with_pii
description: Situation containing an email and a CCN. PII detector flags both with expected severities; the CCN hard-blocks at finalize.
title: Customer escalation post-incident
situation_md: After the 3am rollback, our account exec emailed alice@example.com to apologize. The customer (Globex) also asked us to refund the charge on credit card 4111111111111111 — we passed that to billing.
decision_md: We added a per-customer rollback notification webhook so account execs are auto-paged. The runbook now lists who pages whom by tier-1/tier-2 status.
outcome_md: Time-to-first-customer-contact dropped from 90 minutes to under 10. No further escalations on this incident.
context_md: Globex account. Slack: #incidents-fy24 channel is the primary coordination space.
